page.overview:
Who is Shein Chunla?

Before being raised Amyrlin Seat she had been the Captain-General of the Green Ajah.

She was the youngest Amyrlin since Deane Aryman, raised seven centuries earlier.

She was the Amyrlin Seat during the Third War of Garen's Wall. It is widely believed by historians that she completely mishandled the situation, and caused the war. It is also believed she died in the White Tower of natural causes.

However in the secret histories held in the Thirteenth Depository of the Tower Library, it has been recorded that Shein Chunla was controlled by the Hall of the Tower during this time.
